origin: Independently written bounded reservation workload based on the stale-sale-count pattern of Yogar EX1 airline-25.i. Four agents and capacity three, one mutex protecting accesses, protected post-join exact-fill contract rather than the upstream upper bound.
thread_bound: Exactly four agents, each makes one request; main creates all four and joins all four.
property: After all agents finish, three seats have been sold.
assumptions: The initial sold count is zero. At least three requests are available. All four agents complete one reservation attempt.
intent: Hold the booking mutex continuously across the read, capacity test and conditional write.
